line-up-the-shot-concealment-and-health.scope: Level-20 stock client with Rifles and Concealment refused uncovered 506 locally. Concealed use sent the full stock ability request, charged a single 30 IS, cast for 4 s and reused in 15 s. Stock records showed +10 Ballistic Damage for 12 s and +25 Ballistic Accuracy for 20 s. Healing preserved both. Health loss after 12 s cleared Concealment and left accuracy until 20 s. Early health loss cleared both timed records. The two 1137 reapplications follow the distinct shipped Subject and ApplyAuraEffect callbacks.
